note: Real digests for version 0.3.0, built from the plugin repository's main branch at commit 693155cbd1e4 (make release-with-prebuilt-fpp10 VERSION=0.3.0). This version adds the channel ranges the brightness ceiling leaves alone and writes both channel-range lists through the plugin's own routes, because FPP cuts a plugin setting off at its first comma when saved through its own forms. Those exact artifacts are published as the v0.3.0 pre-release on ShowMeshSystems/showmesh-fpp-plugin, the default artifact host. Regenerate this file from the manifest whenever a new release is cut; there is no tooling that does it automatically. The three native-prebuilt-fpp10 objects were built once each against FPP 10.0 on an Apple Silicon Mac under Docker Desktop; no second host has rebuilt and compared them.
